newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Collectibles files 2.7 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Collectibles files 2.7 mln shrs.

text.p: Collectibles USA Inc filed an initial public offering with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday of up to 2.7 million common shares at an estimated price of $11 a share.
The underwriters for the offering, Ladenburg Thalmann & Co Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 405,000 shares.

The New York-based retailer of animation art products said it will use the proceeds from the offering, an estimated $23.6 million, to pay outstanding debt, to finance the conversion of convertible preferred shares and to fund the acquisition of the founding companies from current shareholders.
After the offering, the company will have 6,198,784 shares outstanding.
